name: Verdurous-Antiphon

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near petrified remnants of former biosphere that no expedition has ever claimed.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in silicon and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
